package.raceSetupsDescription: Create up to three National Team race setups in the same way as the club Equipment page. Setup 1 is created automatically as a complete Flat configuration. Setups 2 and 3 start empty and can be named and configured by the active National Coach. Each setup uses one Frame, Wheelset, Tires, Groupset, Helmet and Shoes from the shared National Team equipment pool.

guide.title: Vodič Nacionalnog saveza
guide.activationText: Novi nacionalni savez počinje sa statusom Formiranje. Postaje aktivan kada se učlani najmanje pet kvalifikovanih menadžera i kada se u potpunosti prikupi jednokratnih 50 Coins za osnivanje. Ta uplata je trajna i ne pravi budžet saveza. Posle aktivacije savez važi do 1. februara sledeće sezone. Od 1. januara članovi mogu zajedno da finansiraju obnovu od 30 Coins; do 1. februara moraju biti ispunjeni i obnova i uslov od pet članova, inače savez postaje neaktivan.
guide.electionsText: Once the Association is active, its members elect the National Coach. Candidate registration opens first, then members vote, and tied leaders can continue into runoff rounds until there is a unique winner. Every active member has exactly one vote in each election round, including candidates. Coin contributions never affect voting power. The Elections tab shows the current coach, election phase, dates within the current Season, candidates, manifestos and voting actions.
guide.selectionText: The National Coach manages sporting selection. The coach can send provisional call-ups to eligible riders, and each rider's club must accept the call-up before that rider can be included in the final squad. The coach then confirms a 10-rider National Team squad. For each competition race day, exactly seven riders are selected from that confirmed squad, with the normal rules controlling how many changes may be made between consecutive race days.
guide.packageText: Svaki Nacionalni savez dobija isti sistemski pokriven paket opreme, vozila i zaliha. Selektor može da sačuva tri kompleta opreme, a resursi se ne troše.
guide.worldNationsText: Tab Competition sadrži World Nations. Planiranje, datumi grupa, države domaćini i paketi ruta pripremaju se već u januaru. Svaki aktivni savez automatski učestvuje. U Sezoni 1 spisak učesnika ostaje otvoren do 1. juna kako bi novi savezi imali vremena da se formiraju, dok su struktura i rute domaćina već ranije vidljive.
guide.chatHistoryText: Članovi saveza dele privatni Timski čet. Istorija trajno čuva aktivaciju, članstva, izbore, selektore, sastave, šampione i World Nations rezultate.
guide.membershipText: Your country's National Association is the shared home for eligible human-controlled clubs from that country. Joining makes your club an Association member, gives you access to member functions such as elections and Team Chat, and places your riders in the pool that can be considered for National Team call-ups. Membership does not guarantee selection, and leaving the Association removes your active membership without deleting the Association's permanent history.
guide.equipmentText: The Association does not buy equipment and does not maintain a treasury for equipment costs. The game provides the same National Team equipment pool, race-support assets and race supplies to every Association. The active National Coach can save three named race setup configurations. Setup 1 begins with a complete Flat setup, while setups 2 and 3 are available for custom configurations. Equipment stays at 100% condition, National Team resources are system-covered, and the Equipment page shows the same weighted setup bonus logic used by club Equipment.
guide.competitionText: World Nations planiranje generiše se u januaru kako bi kvalifikacione grupe, datumi, domaćini i stranice trka bili spremni ranije. Svaka grupa ima jednu državu domaćina za sva tri dana: ekipni hronometar, ravničarsku drumsku trku i brdsku/planinsku trku. Zato prijava domaćina zahteva sva tri tipa etapa iz iste države. U Sezoni 1 spisak učesnika ostaje otvoren do 1. juna; kasnije sezone koriste normalno rano zaključavanje.
guide.chatText: Team Chat is a private Association room for active members. Members can read the conversation at any time and can join the live room when they want to post. Joining the live room also shows the member in the active-participant list. Live presence expires after inactivity, but the message history remains available to Association members.
guide.historyText: The History tab is the long-term record of the National Association across Seasons. It keeps important governance and sporting events such as Association creation and activation, membership changes, activation contributions, National Coach elections and appointments, confirmed National Team squads, National Champions and completed World Nations results. Changing coach, becoming inactive or moving into a new Season does not erase the previous record.

squad.coachOnlyTitle: Squad management is reserved for the National Coach
squad.coachOnlyText: Only the active National Coach can open this page, build the 10-rider selection, lock invitations, manage replacements and confirm the final National Team squad.
squad.timelineDescription: Choose the provisional 10 first. Nothing is sent while the selection remains a draft. When you lock the 10 riders, invitations are sent automatically to their clubs. Clubs then have the response window to accept or decline. A rider with no reply by the deadline is automatically accepted for National Team duty. Explicit declines reopen only those places for replacement; accepted and still-pending riders stay locked.
squad.step1Text: Build and save a provisional list. You may change it freely until you lock the selection.
squad.step2Text: Locking freezes the chosen riders and automatically sends National Team invitations to the responsible clubs.
squad.step3Text: Clubs may accept or decline. No response by the deadline becomes an automatic acceptance, so silence cannot remove a rider after the window closes.
squad.step4Text: When all 10 places are accepted or auto-accepted, confirm the squad. After confirmation the 10-rider squad is locked for that cycle.
squad.selectedTenDescription: This is the working National Team squad. Draft riders can be changed until the list is locked. After invitations are sent, accepted and pending riders stay fixed; only explicitly declined places can be replaced.
squad.replacementHelp: One or more clubs explicitly declined. Keep all accepted and pending riders, replace only the declined places, return the list to 10 riders, then lock again to send invitations to the replacements.
squad.awaitingHelp: Invitations have been sent. The selected riders are locked while clubs respond. If a club does not answer by the deadline, that rider is automatically accepted.
squad.confirmedHelp: The final 10-rider National Team squad is confirmed and locked for this selection cycle.
squad.riderPoolDescription: All eligible riders from this nation are listed below. Use filters and sorting to compare role, age, National Ranking, masked Overall, exact core skills, current fatigue and the National Team selection calculations. The calculation is a planning aid only; it does not add any hidden rider performance bonus.
squad.scoreExplanation: Selection score is a neutral planning calculation using the rider's core skills. Flat, Climbing and Time Trial sub-scores use discipline-specific weightings. These values help the National Coach compare riders; they do not change race-engine performance by themselves.
